title: From flat star-to-event labels to 气→象→事 and layered representation
old_model: Encode stars as flat labels such as leadership, wealth or change, then aggregate favorable/unfavorable signs.
observed_limitations: The flat labels collapse star core, star-system interaction, palace context and observed events.
A single valence score cannot represent state change separately from contextual suitability.
Combinatorial cases cannot be enumerated without explosion.
current_model: Use 气 as an operational latent-state representation, 象 as contextual manifestation family, and 事 as observable event candidate; separate L0-L4 layers, single-star base states, nonlinear star-system interactions, modifiers, palace projections and temporal inputs.
rationale: Preserve source conditions and relational structure while making the representation computable and auditable.
consequences: Source wording and research normalization stay distinct.
Latent-state changes and contextual valence stay distinct.
The sixty star systems can express interaction deltas and context gates.
The ontology remains revisable when source evidence does not support an existing dimension.
what_remains_valid: The model still depends on source-grounded extraction and explicit uncertainty.
The research representation does not assert a physical qi mechanism.
claim_effects: Supports CL-001 and CL-002; reinforces CL-003.
boundaries: 气→象→事 is a research knowledge-representation framework, not a verbatim classical-source statement.
Candidate dimensions and interaction functions remain provisional where not frozen.
